Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Lee, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. LEE:
(sighing)
Jack, it's time for your medication. You know it's good for you 🤒.

JACK:
(refusing)
No! I don't want it! It's poison! 🚽

DR. LEE:
(firmly)
Jack, you need to take your medication. It's the only way to manage your symptoms 📊.

JACK:
(standing up)
I don't need it! I can handle it on my own 💪.

DR. LEE:
(frustrated)
Jack, you're not thinking clearly. You need to take your medication or you'll end up in a worse state 🤕.

JACK:
(smirking)
Oh, I'm thinking just fine. And I'm not taking anything from you 🤣.

Dr. Lee's expression darkens, and he takes a step closer to Jack, his voice taking on a menacing tone 😬.

DR. LEE:
(firmly)
Fine. I'll take it myself. (he reaches for the pills)

Jack's eyes widen in surprise, and he takes a step back, a look of mock fear on his face 😱.

JACK:
(backing away)
No! Don't do it! You'll poison yourself! 💀

Dr. Lee ignores Jack's warnings and opens his mouth to swallow the pills. As he does, the room begins to distort and blur, like a painting melting in the rain 🌂.

When Dr. Lee opens his eyes, he finds himself alone in the room, with no sign of Jack or the medication 🤔. He looks around, confused, and that's when he sees it: a figure standing in the corner of the room, watching him 👀.

It's Jack, but not as he was before. He's a figment of Dr. Lee's imagination, a manifestation of his own paranoid delusions 🤯.

JACK:
(smiling)
You're the one who's been sick all along, Doc. You're the one who's been living in a world of your own making 🌐.

Dr. Lee's eyes widen in shock as he realizes the truth: he's been the one with the schizophrenia all along 🤯.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
